description: This file contains a PHP trait 'FieldableEntityNormalizerTrait' used in Drupal for normalizing and denormalizing fieldable entities, including methods for entity type determination, bundle extraction, and field data processing.

classes.name: FieldableEntityNormalizerTrait
classes.description: A PHP trait providing normalization and denormalization methods for fieldable entities in Drupal.

methods.name: determineEntityTypeId
methods.description: Determines the entity type ID to be used for denormalization, allowing override via context.

methods.name: getEntityTypeDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves the entity type definition for a given entity type ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: extractBundleData
methods.description: Extracts and validates bundle information from data for entity creation.

methods.name: denormalizeFieldData
methods.description: Denormalizes each field's data and sets it on the entity.

methods.name: getEntityTypeRepository
methods.description: Returns the entity type repository service.

methods.name: getEntityFieldManager
methods.description: Returns the entity field manager service.

methods.name: getEntityTypeManager
methods.description: Returns the entity type manager service.

methods.name: constructValue
methods.description: Builds a field item value from incoming data, supporting nested denormalization.
